title: Kaivalya Pada
summary: The final chapter discusses the nature of liberation (Kaivalya), the mechanics of karma, and the ultimate transcendence of the gunas.

verses.translation: The powers (Siddhis) are born of birth, medicinal herbs, mantras, austerities, or Samadhi.
verses.meaning: janma - birth; aushadhi - herbs; mantra - sacred chants; tapah - austerity; samadhijah - born of samadhi; siddhayah - powers

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषार्थशून्यानां गुणानां प्रतिप्रसवः कैवल्यं स्वरूपप्रतिष्ठा वा चित्शक्तिरिति ||
verses.translation: Kaivalya is the state of resolution of the gunas, being devoid of the purpose of the Purusha; it is the re-establishment of the power of consciousness in its own nature.
verses.transliteration: puruṣārtha-śūnyānāṁ guṇānāṁ pratiprasavaḥ kaivalyaṁ svarūpapratiṣṭhā vā citiśaktir iti
verses.meaning: purusha-artha - purpose of purusha; shunyanam - devoid of; gunanam - of the gunas; pratiprasavah - Resolution; kaivalyam - liberation...
